Terminal.Title: SSH terminal
Terminal.Instructions: Ctrl+Shift+C to copy · Ctrl+Shift+V to paste · Ctrl+Tab to move focus
Terminal.OpenHint: Open an interactive shell on the connected VPS. Input is sent only while this terminal is running.
Terminal.Closed: Terminal closed. Select Open terminal to start a new shell.
Terminal.Exited: The remote shell exited. Select Open terminal to start a new shell.
Terminal.Disconnected: The VPS is disconnected. Connect again before opening a terminal.
Terminal.Unavailable: An interactive shell is unavailable for this connection.
Terminal.Failed: The terminal could not continue. Check the connection and open a new terminal.
Terminal.InputOverflow: The input limit was reached. The terminal was closed; no input will be replayed. Open a new terminal and paste a smaller amount.
Terminal.OutputOverflow: The terminal output limit was reached. The shell was closed. Open a new terminal and limit the command output.
Terminal.ClipboardUnavailable: The clipboard is unavailable. Try again.
Terminal.PasteLimit: Paste is limited to 1 MiB. Paste a smaller amount.
